cards.headline: Markets closed for the weekend
cards.body: US equity markets are shut for the weekend, so the tape is frozen at the previous session's close. Everything below reflects that last close — not live trading — and refreshes when the market reopens.

cards.headline: Last close: a broad bid, 60% of energy names green
cards.body: SPX -0.40% · WTI -0.20% · Brent +0.02% · NatGas -3.29%. At the last close, 60% of 67 energy names were green — a broad bid. Oilfield Services did the heavy lifting at +1.72%.

cards.headline: Oilfield Services leads, Grid, Storage & Electrification lags
cards.body: Strongest energy sector is Oilfield Services at +1.72%; weakest is Grid, Storage & Electrification at -2.09%. Rotation within the energy trade, not a one-way move.

cards.headline: EOSE is the standout at +5.52%
cards.watch: Hot means attention, not direction — watch whether the leaders hold the bid or fade into the next session.
